rationale: Every reachable non-Advanced workflow and required outcome needs evidence. Repeating every outcome in all four input modes is not the default gate: shared interaction patterns can be qualified once with an explicit source/behavior crosswalk. Unrun behavior never becomes passed through reuse.
requiredGates: Every workflow has actual ordinary-path browser evidence, or an explicit reviewed external capability/product limit.
All663 inventoried outcomes remain individually accountable; safety, failure, stale-owner and pending/unknown effects are targeted mandatory proofs where applicable.
Every unique input/navigation pattern has appropriate compact and keyboard/touch qualification.
A shared-pattern claim covers only its tested layout/input behavior, never the target workflow effect, scope, data identity or unrun state.
Keep source/build/fixture/provider/real-device limits attached to every observation.

browserSteps: Choose completed turn in a bounded saved page
Observe distinct selected chat through exact user anchor
Observe version-bound appended draft without sending
Restore as new version while retaining draft
Reopen and inspect acknowledged saved value
Inspect actual selected mode and accessible standard actions
Observe final content and qualified intermediate folding
Inspect saved preference independently of browser capability
Inspect truthful completion and preserved neighbors
Confirm exact staged target and inspect admission receipt
limits: Actual restart effect is not claimed; synthetic admission/refusal control workflow only.

browserSteps: Observe its confirmed destination without selecting a replacement chat

unmappedOrdinaryPaths: All remaining workflow paths stay required; some already have outcome evidence but need an explicit ordinary-path mapping. Do not infer completeness from source/test titles.

sharedPatterns.permittedReuse: Standard Settings destinations, compact Back and Close behavior. No save/effect credit for unrun destinations.
Explicit focus+Space/Enter and touch/pointer activation of observed toggle/radio controls. Native OS select-popup gesture and full sequential Tab order remain unqualified.
Observed pending disabled/retained preference behavior only. Other saves require their own outcome assertions.
Observed review/Cancel/expired-token/confirm pattern in disposable history. No new data scope or active-owner exception inferred.
Observed narrow/keyboard/touch focus, explicit target and warning pattern. Actual host restart remains separate.
Mermaid and DOT pointer/touch/keyboard navigation only; no other renderer equivalence.
Observed archive notice/navigation intent, unsaved Canvas/Settings and narrow layout only; unrelated operation notices remain unqualified.

summaryDefinitions.ordinaryPathObserved: All explicitly mapped ordinary indices have passed browser claims; remaining exceptional outcomes may still be open.
summaryDefinitions.allOutcomesObservedInContext: Every inventoried outcome has a passed browser claim in a named appropriate context; no claim of every provider/device/layout.
summaryDefinitions.optionalVariants: Original four-mode matrix is retained as discovery/risk guidance, not a Cartesian release or day-completion gate.
